verdict.rationale: Column is a developer-focused bank and banking-as-a-service platform, so built-in AI for operations is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack shows no first-party AI for natural-language transaction search, drafted dispute or alert responses, or anomaly summaries. The unified transfer query endpoint, reports, webhooks and llms.txt are ordinary API and documentation features, not built-in AI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, the product ships its own AI for banking operations — natural-language search over transactions, drafted responses to disputes and alerts, anomaly summaries — built in, not bolted on
